protocol.tier: L3 (128/256-square distinct-tile batch, 2 tiles/scene, 24 records each); NOT the actual 24-tile target; no actual-target claims
protocol.lease: exclusive local-program lease: sequential children only, no pytest/builds/profilers alongside; unrelated OS/browser system activity recorded per run via loadavg + ps, never claimed absent
protocol.same_resource: identical RuntimeOptions per paired cell: memory_budget_bytes pinned 12 GiB via dataclasses.replace, cpu_budget=4, block_pixels=1024, checkpoint_interval=1, cache_enabled=True, legacy_cache_policy='recompute'

temps.cold: fresh run dir + fresh NUMBA_CACHE_DIR (cold geometry cache, cold JIT, inside timer)
temps.warm_geom: same run dir, FRESH NUMBA_CACHE_DIR (geometry+exports warm, JIT cold again)
temps.warm_full: same run dir + same NUMBA_CACHE_DIR (fully warm)

stages.B_svf_geometry: api.calculate_svf patch_option=2 overwrite=False (shared C6-10 recipe production + export/publication; C6-40 phase barrier when it fires)

protocol.labels: single-run observations; warm_full x3 medians are dev-tier paired observations, no statistical claims

scene_t128.tile_distinction: motif height/tree shift by tile index (deterministic, no RNG)
scene_t128.motif: dense_urban 32-pixel motif (pinned p7 generator lineage), no RNG
scene_t128.layout: processed_inputs/{Building_DSM,DEM,Trees,metfiles}; walls/aspect/SVF/cache are produced INSIDE the measured stages, pristine scene has none

scene_t256.layout: processed_inputs/{Building_DSM,DEM,Trees,metfiles}; walls/aspect/SVF/cache are produced INSIDE the measured stages, pristine scene has none
